description: Inspect shows, then fails: context.kdl alone streams every item through the reference processor — the context types (slots now carrying their accumulation policy, the source-context record and its mode enum, and the snapshot index-entry data model), the slot, accumulate, source-context, and effect node declarations, and the closing scope records arrive as typed declarations — then the compile stage rejects the lone contributing document with KDLITH-DLC008, because the types it references are declared in the sibling contributing documents, as vet dialect does, and the run exits 1; merged reads all four and exits 0
